decisions.diagnosis: Counter 200 failed after the March 2022 floods and recorded only a few percent of the riders until it was replaced by counter 258 on 2022-04-27.
decisions.evidence: Site total 0-73/day (April mean ~17/day) while neighbours 190/191 on the same bank ran at 300-1000/day (April 2022 ratio 187/190 = 0.13 vs ~1.25 normally); counter 258 read 232-1086/day from 2022-04-27, at the usual ratio.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter 200 was starting to fail: it undercounted just before it collapsed.
decisions.evidence: 187/191 daily ratio 0.75, 0.78, 0.56 on 03-21..03-23 against ~1.0-1.3 on the days before (e.g. 03-20: 1103 vs 996). Afternoon hours on 03-21 read 20-25 vs 46-47 at 191.

decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed real lows on a storm weekend; neighbours dropped just as far.
zero_outage removed real lows during the February 2020 floods.
zero_outage removed real lows during the March 2021 floods.
decisions.evidence: 187: 99, 1, 8, 2, 2 vs 190: 121, 4, 16, 8, 15. The riverside path was flooded and 186 read 2, 0, 0, 0.

decisions.diagnosis: zero_outage removed real lows during the March 2022 floods; the counter was still working, as 03-05 and 03-10 show.
zero_outage removed real lows during the July 2022 floods.
zero_outage removed a real storm-day low.

Counter 258 read about 20-25% low relative to its neighbours for exactly two calendar months. This could be a detour or works, or it could be reduced sensor sensitivity; nothing in the data settles which.
decisions.evidence: 187/190 monthly ratio: 1.27 in Oct 2023, then 1.03 in Nov and 1.01 in Dec, then 1.33 in Jan 2024. 190/195 stayed at 0.70-0.74 throughout. Both directions dropped alike, and the slot pattern looks normal.

series.name: Westbound
series.evidence: Counter 258 replaced 200 at the same site (2022-04-24 to 04-27). Both 213 and 640 are labelled West and have the stronger weekday AM peak. Level relative to neighbour 190 is ~1.25 before and ~1.28 after.

series.name: Eastbound
series.evidence: Counter 258 replaced 200 at the same site. Both 225 and 638 are labelled East and have the stronger weekday PM peak. Level relative to 190/191 is unchanged across the swap.

summary: Parramatta River north-bank path under Wilde Ave, counted by counter 200 (2019-03 to 2022-04) and its like-for-like replacement 258 (2022-04 to 2024-02), which reads comparably and is joined into one West and one East series. Counter 200 failed after the March 2022 floods, from about 2022-03-21 until it was replaced on 2022-04-27; those days are set missing. The automatic zero_outage fixes all fall on flood or storm days when neighbouring counters dropped just as far, so they are restored. A two-month 20% dip in Nov-Dec 2023 is left as uncertain.
